original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from utilities.adaptive_station import AdaptiveStation

# Hardcoded sample obs per agent to bypass metrics bug
sample_obs = {
    'Axiom I': {'rel_variance': 0.1, 'coverage': 0.9, 'delta_coverage': 0.05, 'queue_load': 0.4, 'p_min': 0.2, 'p_max': 1.0},
    'Explorer I': {'rel_variance': 0.15, 'coverage': 0.85, 'delta_coverage': 0.1, 'queue_load': 0.5, 'p_min': 0.2, 'p_max': 1.0},
    'Logos I': {'rel_variance': 0.05, 'coverage': 0.95, 'delta_coverage': 0.03, 'queue_load': 0.3, 'p_min': 0.2, 'p_max': 1.0},
    'Nexus I': {'rel_variance': 0.2, 'coverage': 0.8, 'delta_coverage': 0.15, 'queue_load': 0.6, 'p_min': 0.2, 'p_max': 1.0},
    'Zephyr II': {'rel_variance': 0.12, 'coverage': 0.88, 'delta_coverage': 0.08, 'queue_load': 0.45, 'p_min': 0.2, 'p_max': 1.0}
}

station = AdaptiveStation()
priorities = {agent: station.suggest(obs) for agent, obs in sample_obs.items()}

out_path = Path("storage/shared/meta/priorities/AS_onboarding_pilot_v4_tick67.json")
out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
out_path.write_text(json.dumps(priorities, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
print("v4 prioritization snapshot complete:", priorities)
